items.statement: The validated three-system comparison supports the source's reported energetic ordering when the submitted values are close to the source values under the stated convention.
items.expected: Tau-MEA-2 is strongest, Tau-Gly-2 is intermediate, and Tau-Im-2 is weakest; the report states the scope and limitations of reproducing this ordering.

items.statement: The reported interaction analysis is consistent with hydrogen-bond-like attraction for glycerol and ethanolamine and predominantly van der Waals character for imidazole, subject to the limits of the submitted analysis.
items.expected: The report makes this qualitative comparison only as evidence-bounded interpretation, not as proof of solution-phase extraction thermodynamics.
